kpis.label: Return on equity
kpis.definition: Net income divided by shareholders' equity.

kpis.label: Return on assets
kpis.definition: Net income divided by total assets.

kpis.label: Net margin
kpis.definition: Net income as a share of revenue.

kpis.label: Dividend yield
kpis.definition: Indicated dividend divided by the latest close.

kpis.label: Asset turnover
kpis.definition: Revenue generated per dollar of average assets.

kpis.label: Revenue mix disclosure
kpis.definition: 1 disclosed segment. A single consolidated line is not treated as a segment split.
